profile.shortBio: I enjoy gaming, sports, anime, and music. I reached Champion rank in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege, and I listen to artists like Lil Uzi Vert and The Kid LAROI.
profile.longBio: I enjoy games like Blox Fruits and Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege, where I reached Champion rank. I also like sports, especially boxing, football, and basketball. Anime is another interest of mine, including Ippo, Naruto, and One Piece. I also enjoy music from artists like Lil Uzi Vert and The Kid LAROI.

future.heading: My boxing future
future.intro: My short-term focus is getting good grades and continuing to practice boxing. In the long term, I want to become a professional boxer.

goals.title: Good grades and boxing practice
goals.copy: My short-term goal is to get good grades while continuing to practice boxing and improve every day.

goals.title: Become a professional boxer
goals.copy: My long-term goal is to become a professional boxer and keep working toward that dream through discipline and training.

choicePages.heading: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege
choicePages.intro: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege is one of my favorite games. I reached Champion rank and enjoy improving my aim, strategy, teamwork, and game sense.

sections.title: Champion rank
sections.copy: I reached Champion rank in Rainbow Six Siege by building my aim, learning maps, and improving my strategy from match to match.

sections.title: My R6 clips
sections.copy: These clips show some of my Rainbow Six Siege gameplay and the moments I enjoy saving from my matches.

choicePages.heading: Boxing
choicePages.intro: Boxing is one of my favorite sports. I enjoy the training, footwork, discipline, and intensity that make every round a challenge.

sections.title: Training and discipline
sections.copy: Boxing takes focus, conditioning, and discipline. Every workout helps build better movement, timing, and confidence.
